text: You yourself, as much as anybody in the entire universe, deserve your love and affection.
author: Buddha

text: We accept the love we think we deserve.
author: Stephen Chbosky
source: The Perks of Being a Wallflower

text: Being single used to mean that nobody wanted you. Now it means you're pretty sexy and you're taking your time deciding how you want your life to be and who you want to spend it with.
author: Sarah Jessica Parker

text: I call it being 'self-partnered.'
author: Emma Watson

text: I'm single because I was born that way.
author: Mae West
source: The Wit and Wisdom of Mae West

text: Being single is definitely better than being with the wrong person.
author: Hassan Choughari

text: To fall in love with yourself is the first secret to happiness.
author: Robert Morley

text: Love yourself first and everything else falls into line. You really have to love yourself to get anything done in this world.
author: Lucille Ball

text: Single is no longer a lack of options – but a choice. A choice to refuse to let your life be defined by your relationship status but to live every day Happily and let your Ever After work itself out.
author: Mandy Hale

text: You do not need to be loved, not at the cost of yourself. The single relationship that is truly central and crucial in a life is the relationship to the self.
author: Jo Coudert

text: To love oneself is the beginning of a lifelong romance.
author: Oscar Wilde

text: Being with no one is better than being with the wrong one. Sometimes, those who fly solo have the strongest wings.
author: Nitya Prakash

text: This is a good sign, having a broken heart. It means we have tried for something.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: People would be a lot better off if they'd enjoy being single.
author: Lewis Black

text: I never found a companion that was so companionable as solitude.
author: Henry David Thoreau

text: The most important relationship in your life is the one you have with yourself.
author: Diane von Furstenberg

text: Too many women throw themselves into romance because they're afraid of being single, then start making compromises and losing their identity. I won't do that.
author: Candace Bushnell

text: Being single is about celebrating and appreciating your own space that you're in.
author: Kelly Rowland

text: I love being single. It's almost like being rich.
author: Sue Grafton

text: Being single doesn't necessarily mean you're available. Sometimes you have to put up a sign that says 'Do Not Disturb' on your heart.
author: Wiz Khalifa

text: What a lovely surprise to finally discover how unlonely being alone can be.
author: Ellen Burstyn

text: Friendship ... is born at the moment when one man says to another "What! You too? I thought that no one but myself . . ."
author: C.S. Lewis

text: A friend is someone who knows all about you and still loves you.
author: Elbert Hubbard

text: The pain of being alone is completely out of this world, isn't it? I don't know why, but I understand your feelings so much, it actually hurts.
author: Gaara

text: The only person you are destined to become is the person you decide to be.
author: John Acuff

text: I am not afraid of storms, for I am learning how to sail my ship.
author: Louisa May Alcott

text: You don't need someone to complete you. You need someone to join you.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: I have often found the best company in myself.
author: Maya Angelou

text: There is something wrong with a character that by nature inclines to enslave itself.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: No one can make you feel inferior without your consent.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: Nothing is impossible. The word itself says 'I'm possible.'
author: Audrey Hepburn

text: Let the beauty we love be what we do. There are hundreds of ways to kneel and kiss the ground.
author: Rumi

text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
author: Rumi

text: You are the creator of your own reality. Stop looking outside of yourself for validation.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: The thing is, I'm not trying to be someone's everything. I'm just trying to be my own.
author: Michelle Obama

text: In the future, there will be no female leaders. There will just be leaders.
author: Sheryl Sandberg

text: I'm like a bird. If you cage me up, I'll die. I need to be free.
author: Luffy

text: I want to live in a world where I can be myself. That's all I've ever wanted.
author: Luffy

text: I don't want to depend on someone else. I want to stand on my own two feet and protect what matters to me.
author: Hinata Hyuga

text: I'm going to become someone who doesn't need anyone to tell me who I am.
author: Sasuke Uchiha

text: Individuality isn't something you find. It's something you create, one choice at a time.
author: Lelouch vi Britannia

text: I don't need anyone's approval. My heart already knows who I am.
author: Bakugo Katsuki

text: A person who doesn't rely on others is someone the world can't break.
author: Bakugo Katsuki

text: We don't need to understand everything. We just have to understand enough to move forward.
author: Edward Elric

text: I've learned that the world doesn't owe me anything. Everything I have, I earned.
author: Killua Zoldyck

text: Freedom is the one thing I refuse to give up. Not for love, not for anyone.
author: Killua Zoldyck

text: I want to find my own words. Words that belong to me and no one else.
author: Violet Evergarden

text: There is meaning in every moment, even the ones spent alone. Especially those.
author: Violet Evergarden

text: I've died so many times. Each time I came back a little more myself. Dying taught me how to live.
author: Subaru Natsuki

text: The world will try to tell you who you are. Don't listen. Go find out for yourself.
author: Kirito

text: I wanted to live. Not just exist — to truly live, to feel everything and hold nothing back.
author: Liz

text: The secret of life is to notice everything in a fiction, and forget everything in reality.
author: Walter Mitty
source: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty (2013)

text: Sometimes the best adventures start alone.
author: Jules

text: I'm not just a single woman. I'm a woman who chose herself first, and that's the most powerful thing in the world.
author: Elle Woods

text: You don't need to be broken to be interesting. You just need to be honest.
author: Lisa Frost

text: You are who you are. That's not a flaw. It's the whole point.
author: Joy

text: Not all who wander are lost. Some of us are just figuring it out as we go.
author: Cheryl Strayed

text: You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to keep moving forward.
author: Claire Standish

text: The most radical thing you can do is be yourself, unapologetically.
author: Taylor Swift

text: I'm not anti-love. I'm pro-self. And sometimes that means choosing yourself first.
author: Beyoncé

text: Being alone is not the same as being lonely. One is a choice. The other is a feeling.
author: Dua Lipa

text: Someone once broke my heart, and I spent an entire year putting myself back together. Turns out, the rebuilt version was better than the original.
author: Adele

text: I am 100% myself, and that is more than enough.
author: Lizzo

text: My whole life I was told I wasn't enough. Then I started believing I was everything.
author: Kesha

text: Since U Been Gone was the best thing that ever happened to me.
author: Kelly Clarkson

text: You learn who you really are when you stop pretending for everyone else.
author: Alanis Morissette

text: Vulnerability is not weakness. It's our greatest measure of courage.
author: Brene Brown

text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do. If you haven't found it yet, keep looking.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: Do what you can, with what you have, where you are.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: I alone cannot change the world, but I can cast a stone across the waters to create many ripples.
author: Maya Angelou

text: The purpose of life is to live it, to taste experience to the utmost, to reach out eagerly and without fear for newer and richer experience.
author: Eleanor Roosevelt

text: Real strength is knowing that you don't have to prove anything to anyone. You just have to be.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: I am no bird; and no net ensnares me. I am a free human being with an independent will.
author: Jane Eyre

text: Growth is silent. One day you wake up and everything that used to break you is no longer a threat.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: You are enough as you are. You have always been enough.
author: Michelle Obama

text: The greatest thing in the world is to know how to belong to oneself.
author: Michel de Montaigne

text: Solitude is not something to be feared. It is a gift to those who know how to unwrap it.
author: Thomas Merton

text: I would rather be alone with my thoughts than surrounded by people who don't understand them.
author: Audrey Hepburn

text: The best relationship you'll ever have is the one you build with yourself.
author: Brene Brown

text: You can't pour from an empty cup. Take care of yourself first.
author: Sheryl Sandberg

text: Adventure is worthwhile in itself.
author: Amelia Earhart

text: I am built from the pieces of myself I refused to throw away.
author: Maya Angelou

text: Not everyone you lose is a loss. Some are lessons. Some are freedom.
author: Taylor Swift

text: If you don't love yourself, how are you gonna love nobody else?
author: Lizzo

text: I'm learning that being alone is not the same as being without. It's realizing I was never truly empty.
author: Beyoncé

text: You were born to break the mold. Never apologize for the space you take up.
author: Adele

text: Happiness is not something that happens to you. It's something you create, every single day, on your own terms.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: The journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step — and that step is entirely yours to take.
author: Lao Tzu

text: I don't need a relationship to feel whole. I am whole. I have always been whole.
author: Brene Brown

text: Being alone gives you space to hear the voice inside you that everyone else drowns out.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: I used to think I needed someone to complete me. Now I know I was already complete — I just didn't see it.
author: Elizabeth Gilbert

text: Self-love is not selfish. It's the foundation everything else is built on.
author: Paulo Coelho

text: There's no playlist for the feeling of finally becoming who you were meant to be.
author: Kelly Clarkson

text: The silence after the storm is where you find yourself again.
author: Rumi

text: I am not looking for someone to fill a void. I am looking for someone to stand beside me in the fullness of who I already am.
author: Michelle Obama

text: Every soul comes to this world with a mission. Yours is to discover yours — alone if you must.
author: Deepak Chopra

text: Independence isn't about doing everything alone. It's about knowing that you can.
author: Sheryl Sandberg

text: Aloneness is a teacher most people are afraid to sit with. But the lesson it gives is worth more than any company.
author: Maya Angelou

text: You are a universe unto yourself. Never shrink to fit someone else's idea of who you should be.
author: Oprah Winfrey

text: The wildest thing you'll ever do is trust yourself. Everything else follows from that.
author: Kesha
